name: test-assistent-mcp-server
description: MCP server for OpenCode that exposes classic test techniques (7), test heuristics (SFDPOT, FEW HICCUPPS, RCRCRC, quality criteria, bug heuristics, test tours), and test data generation (random rows, property-based) as 6 tools.
long_description:
A knowledge-based MCP server for OpenCode agents that provides:

- **catalog_techniques**: list all classic test techniques
- **catalog_heuristics**: list all test heuristics
- **generate_test_cases**: generate testcases for one classic technique at a time (Boundary Value Analysis, Equivalence Partitioning, Decision Table, Pairwise Testing, State Transition, Use Case Testing, Error Guessing) — Pydantic discriminated-union schema
- **generate_test_data**: raw test data — strategy 'random' (N seeded multi-field rows) or 'property' (boundary + random + invalid for one typed field) — Pydantic discriminated-union schema
- **advise_technique**: keyword-based recommendation of techniques and heuristics
- **checklist_for**: produce a test checklist for a given context

The knowledge base (7 techniques + 6 heuristics) is bundled as JSON and loaded at startup.

tools.name: catalog_techniques
tools.description: List all classic test techniques (BVA, equivalence partitioning, decision table, pairwise, state transition, use case, error guessing).

tools.name: catalog_heuristics
tools.description: List all test heuristics (SFDPOT, FEW HICCUPPS, RCRCRC, quality criteria catalog, bug heuristics, test tours).

tools.name: generate_test_cases
tools.description: Generate concrete test cases using a classic test technique (Boundary Value Analysis, Equivalence Partitioning, Decision Table, Pairwise Testing, State Transition, Use Case Testing, Error Guessing). Each call targets exactly one technique.

tools.name: generate_test_data
tools.description: Generate raw test data (values), not technique-driven test cases. strategy='random' produces N seeded rows; strategy='property' produces boundary + random + invalid values for a single typed field.

tools.name: advise_technique
tools.description: Recommend techniques and heuristics for a described testing context via keyword analysis.

tools.name: checklist_for
tools.description: Produce a recommended test checklist (items) for a context, e.g. RCRCRC for regression after a bug fix.
